categories.title: Resilience Against Reverse Engineering and Tampering

controls.MASVS-AUTH-1: The app uses secure authentication and authorization protocols and follows the relevant best practices.
controls.MASVS-AUTH-2: The app performs local authentication securely according to the platform best practices.
controls.MASVS-AUTH-3: The app secures sensitive operations with additional authentication.
controls.MASVS-CODE-1: The app requires an up-to-date platform version.
controls.MASVS-CODE-2: The app has a mechanism for enforcing app updates.
controls.MASVS-CODE-3: The app only uses software components without known vulnerabilities.
controls.MASVS-CODE-4: The app validates and sanitizes all untrusted inputs.
controls.MASVS-CRYPTO-1: The app employs current strong cryptography and uses it according to industry best practices.
controls.MASVS-CRYPTO-2: The app performs key management according to industry best practices.
controls.MASVS-NETWORK-1: The app secures all network traffic according to the current best practices.
controls.MASVS-NETWORK-2: The app performs identity pinning for all remote endpoints under the developer's control.
controls.MASVS-PLATFORM-1: The app uses IPC mechanisms securely.
controls.MASVS-PLATFORM-3: The app uses the user interface securely.
controls.MASVS-PRIVACY-1: The app minimizes access to sensitive data and resources.
controls.MASVS-PRIVACY-2: The app prevents identification of the user.
controls.MASVS-PRIVACY-3: The app is transparent about data collection and usage.
controls.MASVS-PRIVACY-4: The app offers user control over their data.
controls.MASVS-RESILIENCE-1: The app validates the integrity of the platform.
controls.MASVS-RESILIENCE-3: The app implements anti-static analysis mechanisms.
controls.MASVS-RESILIENCE-4: The app implements anti-dynamic analysis techniques.
controls.MASVS-STORAGE-1: The app securely stores sensitive data.
controls.MASVS-STORAGE-2: The app prevents leakage of sensitive data.
